# Guildweaver

> Guildweaver syncs a WoW Forever player's characters, gear, professions and farming to a private dashboard. It is a free desktop companion plus an in-game addon. Sign-in uses Discord; no guild is required.

Players install Guildweaver, connect their computer by signing in with Discord, and play. When they /reload or log out, WoW saves the addon's data and Guildweaver uploads it. The dashboard groups their characters by server and shows equipment, stats, talents, bags, professions and recipes, gathering activity, and sync status.

## Primary pages

- [Guildweaver](/): What Guildweaver does, with download and sign-in.
- [Download](/download): Installers for Windows, macOS and Linux, release verification and data boundaries.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): A signed-in player's own characters, professions, farming and devices.
- [Privacy](/privacy): What Guildweaver collects, who can see it, and how to disconnect.

## Additional pages

- [Item catalog](/items): Community-observed item sources and crafting uses.
- [Website source](https://github.com/Indicaza/holdfast): Public source code for this website.

## Key facts

- Game: WoW Forever.
- Cost: free and open source.
- Sign-in: Discord, used only for identity; it never joins a Discord server or guild.
- Privacy: a player's characters, bags and gold are visible only to that player. Community drop rates are pooled and anonymous.
